decisions.reason: The GIS software platform is the firm's flagship and draws directly on its core engineering knowledge, research and standards work, so the firm is best placed to interpret its results and keep improving it, even though it was not observed on the website in 2020 and 2021.

Mobile field data capture builds closely on the firm's GIS and mobile competence and serves both public and private customers, so its own R&D can keep it current despite the missing website evidence for 2020 and 2021.

Like the small web map plugins already withdrawn in 2019 (A, B and C), this search extension adds little new knowledge, has not been seen on the website since 2018, and is likely better folded into the platform, freeing resources for core development.
